name: Hu et al. Density-based Sampling
definition: A method that evaluates the coarse NeRF MLP only at valid points (positive densities) and the fine network at pivotal points (densities exceeding a predefined threshold).
summary: Hu et al. Density-based Sampling optimizes NeRF rendering by using a single view-independent density field to restrict fine network evaluations to geometrically relevant regions.
